description: A wicker basket with a baguette, a burger, and a banana sits on the table, with a plate of fruit—red grapes, a red apple, and bananas—beside it. The right hand reaches in from the right, grasps a bunch of grapes from the plate as a right-hand object, lifts it up and moves leftward over the basket, then lowers and releases the grapes into the basket before reaching back to pick up the red apple and place it into the basket as well.
